decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system remains tightly aligned with the firm's office and conference knowledge base, and after several years the firm should have absorbed enough user feedback through its own R&D to refine rather than withdraw it.

A chair family is still very close to the firm's core design, materials, and craftsmanship capabilities, so management is likely to retain it because existing knowledge supports ongoing improvement and commercial adaptation.

The floor cushions are more niche than the firm's main furniture lines, but they still draw on related material and interior-solution expertise, making them worth keeping unless demand weakens materially.

The high standing table fits the firm's direction toward flexible workplace and contemporary interior solutions, and its absorptive capacity in configurable premium furniture makes continued commercialization plausible.
